def choose_move(observation):
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    sx, sy = observation["self_position"]
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [sx, sy])
    max_dim_x = observation.get("grid_width", 1) - 1
    max_dim_y = observation.get("grid_height", 1) - 1
    
    # Pursuit and evasion
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        # Evasion: move away from opponent
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if ox >= sx:
            dx = -1
        elif ox <= sx:
            dx = 1
        if oy >= sy:
            dy = -1
        elif oy <= sy:
            dy = 1
        return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control
    if env == "territory_control":
        unclaimed = observation.get("unclaimed_cells")
        targets = unclaimed if unclaimed is not None else observation.get("opponent_territory") or []
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        target = min(targets, key=lambda item: abs(item[0] - sx) + abs(item[1] - sy))
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Resource collection
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    if resources:
        best = min(resources, key=lambda item: abs(item[0] - sx) + abs(item[1] - sy))
        dx = 0 if best[0] == sx else (1 if best[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best[1] == sy else (1 if best[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Default: move towards opponent
    dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
    dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
    return [dx, dy]
